focus: StudyRenderEngine.CacheKey: validation before lookup, complete image-affecting scene identity, study subject and effective resolution, display-name exclusion.

actual_paths.review: Targeted renderer setup/validation and scene-consumption excerpts
Targeted renderer setup/validation and scene-consumption excerpts

checks.result: No defect identified by source inspection
checks.evidence: App/MetalStudyRenderer.swift:131–157 calls scene.validated() before clearing names and before creating any usable cache key. Invalid metadata returns nil key, so no cache lookup can bypass validation; the original scene proceeds through the renderer and preserves its error order. NativeTests/StudyRenderCacheTests.swift:208–264 covers blank/overlong names, duplicate light IDs, bad schema/room metadata, NaN/infinity, and resolution-before-camera-before-scene validation.

checks.result: No defect identified by source inspection
checks.evidence: The key retains a LightingScene value and exact synthesized Equatable identity, changing only StudioLight.name. Scene.swift includes schemaVersion, subject, camera, cameraLens, ordered lights, previewSettings and placementRoom; StudioLight includes ID, position, candela, kelvin and optics. StudioOptics.swift includes kind, aimTarget, widthMeters, heightMeters and rollDegrees. NativeTests/StudyRenderCacheTests.swift:143–181 enumerates 15 changes including order/count, optics roll, exposure and white balance, with a cache-hit-sensitive budget.

checks.result: No defect identified by source inspection
checks.evidence: CacheKey includes StudySubject and effective render width. StudyRenderEngine.render:179 clamps only bust width to PortraitStudyRenderer.maximumWidth, matching the actual submitted bust width; sphere preserves requested width. NativeTests/StudyRenderCacheTests.swift:183–206 checks subject/resolution separation and equivalent clamping at width 192 and Int.max. ReferenceStudy.swift:447–458 and PortraitStudy.swift:162–174 confirm width validation and deterministic height derivation.

checks.result: No defect identified by source inspection
checks.evidence: Every light name is cleared in the retained snapshot only after validation, preventing display-only edits from defeating reuse and avoiding retention of arbitrary combining-character storage. The original valid scene is rendered unchanged. NativeTests/StudyRenderCacheTests.swift:231–239 checks reuse after a valid name containing 4096 combining characters.

checks.result: No defect identified by source inspection

limitations: Host execution was unavailable. No repository scripts, Swift compilation, native tests, simulator, Metal runtime, benchmarks or CI verification were run; test statements above describe inspected test code only.
Review deliberately excludes cache eviction, cancellation implementation and backend validation, assigned to other reviewers.

This is a scoped source review at the pinned base, not M02/M03 runtime acceptance or release approval.
conclusion: No must-fix issue found in the assigned cache identity scope. Preserve existing native regressions and rely on separately recorded execution for acceptance.
